audit_scope.description: Batch 5 covers hardfork activation mechanics (EIP-1588 ProgPoW), gas economics (Cancun gas.py with blob gas and EIP-4844), Berlin fork features (access lists, EIP-2930), SHA256 precompile, and RIP address reservation (EIP-7587). Primary external boundaries are transaction submission with blob data and P2P block propagation.

trusted_external_entities.name: User via JSON-RPC (Blob Transactions)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: JSON-RPC API (eth_sendRawTransaction with type-3 blob transactions)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated RPC endpoint. Blob transactions (EIP-4844) must be validated: blob count ≤ MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK, blob gas price meets blob_gas_price from header (exponential fee market), total blob gas = blob_count * GAS_PER_BLOB (131,072). Transaction must pay both execution gas and blob gas separately.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node via devp2p (Berlin Block Propagation)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: devp2p wire protocol (NewBlock with access list transactions)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated P2P network. Blocks containing EIP-2930 access list transactions must be validated: access list format (array of [address, storage_keys]), access list gas cost (per-address and per-slot charges), warm/cold access accounting. Transaction execution must respect pre-warmed addresses and storage slots.

trusted_external_entities.name: Miner via devp2p (PoW Block Submission)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: devp2p wire protocol (NewBlock with PoW proof)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated P2P network. PoW blocks must be validated: Ethash proof-of-work verification (mix_digest and nonce), difficulty matches expected value (including bomb delay adjustments per EIP-5133/EIP-1588 if applicable), block header fields (parent hash, state root, receipts root, logs bloom) all valid.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Blob transaction validation: (1) max_fee_per_blob_gas ≥ blob_gas_price (from parent excess_blob_gas), (2) blob_versioned_hashes count ≤ 6 (MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK), (3) each versioned hash starts with BLOB_COMMITMENT_VERSION_KZG (0x01), (4) sender balance ≥ (max_fee_per_gas * gas_limit) + (max_fee_per_blob_gas * blob_gas), (5) blob KZG commitments verified via point_evaluation precompile. Blob data itself not in execution payload, only versioned hashes.

Access list transaction validation: (1) access list RLP structure valid (array of [address: Address, storage_keys: List[Bytes32]]), (2) access list gas charged correctly (GAS_ACCESS_LIST_ADDRESS per address + GAS_ACCESS_LIST_STORAGE_KEY per slot), (3) warm/cold accounting: access list items marked warm before execution, first access to unlisted items charges cold cost (GAS_COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS=2600, GAS_COLD_SLOAD=2100), subsequent accesses charge warm cost (GAS_WARM_ACCESS=100).

PoW block validation: (1) Ethash dataset generation using epoch-specific seed, (2) Ethash hash verification: mix_digest = ethash_hash(header_hash, nonce), (3) Difficulty target verification: keccak256(rlp(header_without_mix_and_nonce) + mix_digest + nonce) ≤ 2^256 / difficulty, (4) Difficulty value matches expected: calc_difficulty(parent, timestamp) with bomb delay applied if post-fork. Invalid PoW results in block rejection and potential peer disconnection.
